title: DeepSea official test sequence · C2C12 whole-cell lineages
source: DeepSea author-published tracking_dataset/test/set_8_MC2C12; original images and tab-separated position/lineage labels. Published test split, not newly hand-labeled.
task: Follow ALL 32 seeded whole-cell lineages across ALL 60 supplied phase-contrast frames. At every frame report the positions of ALL currently annotated visible descendants of each seed, including multiple generations. Also report every observed binary division of those seed lineages. Other cells are distractors. Initial seed points are supplied in every condition. Each supplied image is one step; the author selected source frames at increments of four. Division frame means the first supplied frame containing both annotated daughters, not the unobserved physical mitosis time. Coordinates are in ORIGINAL image pixels. Use an empty list when a seeded lineage has no annotated visible descendant. Daughter ordering is irrelevant.

A01.0: [[x,y], ...]; include ALL frames 0..59 and ALL seeds A01..A32

grading.positions: One-to-one matching within 6 pixels after scaling x to 512 and y to 383, matching the distance scale of the author evaluator. Exact descendant cardinality for each seed/frame. Report micro precision/recall/F1 and complete seed/frame accuracy; complete pass requires all fields.
grading.divisions: One-to-one event matching: correct initial root, time within 1 supplied frame, parent and unordered daughter positions within 6 scaled pixels. Report event precision/recall/F1. Exact whole-task pass requires every event and every seed/frame.
grading.metric_scope: Transparent agent-task adaptation using original DeepSea labels. These are NOT the official DeepSea MOTA or CTC LNK/TRA scores; per-root descendant membership and explicit division events are scored.
